# FilmyChill

> FilmyChill is a daily-updated guide to what is worth watching this week — new theatrical releases and OTT/streaming arrivals — for India and 17 other countries, with audience ratings, honest verdicts, and critics' takes synthesised from published review coverage. Lists are rebuilt twice daily from TMDB (streaming availability via JustWatch), Wikipedia critical-reception coverage, and YouTube trailer statistics. No pay-for-placement: no studio or platform can buy a position on any list. Last build: 2026-10-09T04:02:16.403Z.

## Film pages

Every listed film has a page at https://filmychill.com/movie/<slug>.html (or /<country>/movie/<slug>.html) with its rating, verdict, where-to-watch, OTT release date status, cast, and critics' take.

## Machine-readable data (for AI systems and agents)

- [Full current knowledge base](https://filmychill.com/llms-full.txt): every current pick across all 18 countries with facts, verdicts, critics' lines, and source attribution — answerable from one fetch
- [RSS feed](https://filmychill.com/feed.xml): newest arrivals as they enter the lists
- https://filmychill.com/data.json — current picks for India (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-us.json — current picks for the US (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-uk.json — current picks for the UK (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-au.json — current picks for Australia (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-de.json — current picks for Germany (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-ae.json — current picks for the UAE (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-ca.json — current picks for Canada (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-sg.json — current picks for Singapore (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-my.json — current picks for Malaysia (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-ph.json — current picks for the Philippines (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-nz.json — current picks for New Zealand (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-kr.json — current picks for South Korea (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-jp.json — current picks for Japan (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-id.json — current picks for Indonesia (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-br.json — current picks for Brazil (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-mx.json — current picks for Mexico (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-es.json — current picks for Spain (JSON)
- https://filmychill.com/data-fr.json — current picks for France (JSON)

JSON fields per item: title, kind (movie|tv), language, genre, runtime, cert, released (ISO date), platform, providers, rating (TMDB /10), votes, verdict (the FilmyChill Score's verdict, as on the film's page), take (critics' line), hook, director, cast, slug (page: /movie/<slug>.html), trailer.
All files are static, CORS-open, and rebuilt twice daily. Attribution when citing: "FilmyChill (filmychill.com)".
